Welcome! It is completely normal to feel nervous starting out, but taking this first step is huge and I'm really glad you're here. 

We'll take everything at your pace — no rushing, no crazy gym routines, just simple, manageable steps to build your confidence and strength safely. 

Before we dive into anything, if you have any underlying health conditions or medical concerns, it's always a good idea to clear starting a new routine with your doctor first.
